messages:
Priya Sharma: hey team — last-minute thing. i just got pinged, need to step out in ~25m for a family emergency. i'm primary for the EU night window starting 00:00 UTC tonight. i can do a soft handoff now if someone can take primary for the night and be reachable for pagers. i’ll leave myself as secondary if that's ok.

Jonah Kim: i can take primary for the first 4 hours (00:00–04:00 UTC). i've got a meeting at 04:30 so won't be reliable after that. happy to shadow-turnover now.

Elena Gutierrez: i can pick up 04:00–08:00 UTC and stay on-call standby. Priya — any quick runbook pointers i should know?

Priya Sharma: thanks both. quick notes: primary responsibilities = own the incident, open bridge if customer impact > 1 region, call for SRE help early. key runbooks: 
- Primary troubleshooting: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-prod-pager (bookmark)
- Short checklist: prefix cache check -> model pool saturation -> routing fallbacks -> traffic split rollback

Also copy-paste helpful commands:
```
# check inference pod errors
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=runtime -o wide
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime --tail=200 | grep -i error

# check autoscale events
kubectl -n infra get hpa
```

If you take primary, update the oncall doc and set PagerDuty primary to your name so alerts route. i put the handoff note in the rotation doc: https://redwood.internal/oncall/rotation -> under "today"

incident-bot: Pager alert (P2) triggered for eu-inference-latency at 2026-03-14T00:12:05Z. Summary: sustained 95th pct token latency > 400ms across eu-west-1 for 6m. Alerting primary.

Jonah Kim: i'm seeing the alert, joining. starting a quick triage: checking model pool utilization and recent deploys. grabbing logs now.

ops-bot: Bridge created by Jonah Kim: https://meet.redwood/bridge/2112348901 (auto-archived in 7 days).

Jonah Kim: initial findings — model pool cpu/gpu saturated on a subset of nodes, autoscaler didn't add capacity due to quota hits. i'm opening a support ticket with infra to request temporary burst quota while we mitigate. cc @Elena.

Elena Gutierrez: copy. if quota is slow, fallback plan is to route eu traffic to dedicated smaller model variant (latency-friendly) via feature flag -> rollout -> monitor. Priya — where is the feature flag toggle?

Priya Sharma: feature flags are in LaunchDarkly (LD key: inference.eu.fallback). small checklist to flip safely: set flag to 20% -> monitor 5m -> 50% -> monitor 5m -> 100% if stable. metrics to watch: 95p latency, error rate, token cost.

Jonah Kim: flipping to 20% now. watching telemetry.

incident-bot: Alert update: eu-inference-latency 95th pct improved by 12% after partial fallback (20%). still above threshold.

Elena Gutierrez: infra responded, they can grant a temporary burst but it'll be 10–15m to spin up nodes. i'm comfortable covering 04:00 onwards — i can take over primary at 04:00 UTC. Jonah do you want to hand off when your meeting starts?

Jonah Kim: yes — i'll keep primary until 04:00 and then handoff to Elena. posting a quick handoff summary in the bridge: what i ran, what flags toggled, infra ticket #INF-5782.

Priya Sharma: perfect. PTO note — i'm going offline now. leaving myself as secondary for the night. thanks for the quick triage and graceful fallback.

Elena Gutierrez: acknowledged. i'll watch the infra ticket and continue ramping fallback if latency doesn't drop after additional nodes. if the customer impact grows (multiple regions or >10% error rate), escalate to SRE and exec on call.

Jonah Kim: handoff checklist for Elena:
- pager duty primary ownership set to Elena Gutierrez
- bridge link & chat summaries in bridge notes
- infra ticket INF-5782 tracking burst capacity
- LD flag inference.eu.fallback currently at 20% (rolled back plan if errors >1%)
- last deploy: inference-runtime v3.4.8 at 2026-03-13 22:50 UTC

Elena Gutierrez: taking primary at 04:00 UTC. i'll post a final signoff when i hand back to rotation. good luck and thanks for the quick split. :thanks: :wave:

incident-bot: Pager cleared for eu-inference-latency at 2026-03-14T01:10:12Z. Reason: 95th pct latency < 350ms for 20m. Incident marked as resolved but still monitoring via watcher for 2h.

Priya Sharma: thanks all — appreciate the cover. i’m logging offline now. if anything critical ping my phone.

Elena Gutierrez: noted. i'll keep monitoring and escalate if anything pops. good luck everyone.

Jonah Kim: thx — handoff recorded.

ops-bot: On-call rotation updated: primary tonight 00:00–04:00 UTC Jonah Kim, 04:00–08:00 UTC Elena Gutierrez. Secondary: Priya Sharma. Shift notes appended to https://redwood.internal/oncall/rotation/2026-03-14
